entities.name: José Antonio Garcia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Antonio García is a Mexican sound mixer. He was nominated at the 85th Academy Awards for the film Argo in the category of Best Sound Mixing. He shared his nomination with John T. Reitz and Gregg Rudloff. He was also nominated at the 91st Academy Awards, along with Skip Lievsay and Craig Henighan, for the film Roma.
